key_updates: The 370.346M XRP described as external outflow by XRP Insights is outflow from its 13-wallet attribution set, not evidence of sale or departure from BitGo custody.
Q-Eternal's ledger research and nine Bithomp destination pages strongly support internal BitGo custody reorganization across multisig accounts.
The ten-destination tranche table leaves the 600,000 XRP advance-funding subscriber tranche unmapped; the 200,137.78 XRP tracker arithmetic difference remains unresolved.
Two later tagged inflows totaling 9.069762M XRP to the cash-purchased-tranche wallet remain unattributed and are not verified Evernorth purchases.
The October 30 ELOC summary gross figure of $80.7M likely uses the earlier $15.46 reference price while the cover uses $14.71 and $76.8M; no draw is verified.

The filing states yield/DeFi activity commenced following closing, but also says no material ecosystem deployment was expected before Q4 2026 and 100% cold storage as of the prospectus date; actual XRP deployment remains unverified.
source_independence: SEC primary filing; separate public XRPL research providers; Bithomp account explorer corroboration. Underlying ledger data is shared public data, so source independence is methodological rather than independent of the ledger.
